name: mg4rq5-phone-home
goal: Signed-in iPhone home keeps Overview and computer pairing usable when hosted collaboration is disabled, and account actions on both the iPhone and Hub return page have visible spacing.

evidence: The TestFlight home shows the shared-collaboration configuration error after GET /api/projects returns 503 collaboration-disabled. Project Overview and pairing should remain available. The account actions should have 12 CSS px of spacing on the iOS home and the phone-width Hub return page.

The native acceptance covered a paired Overview using a successful empty shared-project list, and the browser return case covered its callback only. Exercise the signed-in unpaired native home with the real Hub refusal and measure visible gaps in both flows before continuing.
